submitted.rationale: Index 5 (Ag0.50Sb0.50, near AgSbO3 stoichiometry) gave the highest measured EQE (0.369%). EQE falls on both sides: index 3 (Ag-richer) gave 0.330% and index 9 (Sb-richer, mostly pyrochlore by XRD) gave 0.161%. That puts the maximum near the 1:1 composition. XRD shows index 5 is a mix: Ag-metal-like peaks at Q≈2.67 and 3.09, plus other phases, including a pyrochlore contribution. Index 1 is dominated by Ag.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE 0.161%, lower than index 5 despite strong pyrochlore XRD
XRD looks like index 9 (pyrochlore, larger lattice), and EQE was trending down toward the Sb-rich end
XRD dominated by Ag-metal peaks, and EQE was already dropping at index 3 on the Ag-rich side
